title: A read-only Claude reviewer child is denied Engram's read words (memories), although its brief allows the startup recovery that project instructions require
outcome: A read-only reviewer child can do the read-only startup recovery its brief says is allowed: Engram's words that only read (at least `memories` without an acknowledging argument, `show`, `ls`, `search`) are admitted for it by exact tool name and argument check, every word or argument that writes stays denied, and the denial of a tracker write says so. What an evaluator child may reach is decided by w-6f4ebd7130f5 and is not widened here.
acceptance: A read-only Claude child that is not an evaluator, on a runtime the host gave the tracker's server, is allowed the tracker's reads that record nothing: `next` with `peek: true`, `ls`, `search`, `show` in every form, and `memories` without a context generation; a test covers each at the permission decision.

Every other tracker call is denied for it: each word that writes (add, claim, update, note, done, gate, evaluate, handoff, remember, forget), `next` without a peek, a context generation on `next` or `memories`, and any argument the gate does not know; the denial lists the reads; a test lists each and checks the denial.

The admission is by the tracker server's qualified tool name only, and only for the running child of a delegation that is not an evaluator whose runtime the host gave the tracker's server: an evaluator child, a finished delegation, a root session and a look-alike tool name are refused; tests cover each.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.

docs/features/agent-delegation-sessions.md states which tracker calls a read-only Claude child may make, and says from the source how read-only Kimi and Codex children differ today; each difference is filed as its own item and cited in a note.

completion.summary: Train-2 package landed at 9c80a234; acceptance evaluation 19841874b43b4f52a6109b9ad5c939e0 passed 5/5.
